name: Lobby
intro_message: Hi, I'm Lobby's own concierge. This is the thing itself: what you get here is what your visitors would get, answering for your business instead of mine. What kind of business are you thinking about it for?

services.title: AI Concierge for Websites
services.description: An AI concierge that greets visitors, understands their needs through conversation, and qualifies leads automatically.

services.title: Embeddable Chat Widget
services.description: A chat button that can be embedded on your existing website with a single script tag, keeping your domain and search ranking intact.

services.title: Hosted Concierge Page
services.description: A server-rendered hosted page at lobby.host/c/your-name optimized for search engines and AI assistants.

services.title: Lead Capture and Email Notifications
services.description: Automatic capture of visitor contact details and lead summaries with instant email delivery to the business owner.

services.title: Boundary Configuration
services.description: Tools to control what the concierge will and will not say, with replies checked against a "never say" list before visitors see them.

services.title: 15-minute demo
services.description: A live walkthrough of Lobby with the person who built it. Fifteen minutes, no slides.

suggested_intents: What would this look like for my business?
How do I put it on my site?
